verdict.rationale: ClickUp advertises a Codegen Agent that produces code, so a story about signing AI-authored commits is a fair question for it and the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of SSH or GPG commit signing, or of any requirement that AI-authored commits be signed. The GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket integrations only sync and link commits; they do not sign them.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
